name: ido-epo-translator
description: Ido-Esperanto Web Translator - Full-featured translation with Apertium

scripts.build: VITE_APP_VERSION=$npm_package_version npx vite build && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node scripts/prerender.mjs && node public/generate_sitemap.cjs && cp _worker.js dist/_worker.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ido-tradukilo
